newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu extends gains vs drachma above 308 after fix.
newsitem.headline: Ecu extends gains vs drachma above 308 after fix.

text.p: The Ecu's positive trend against the drachma persisted, taking it to fresh intraday highs above the 308 level after the fixing, as traders expected the dollar to rise against the drachma on dollar buying linked to the maturing on April 22 of a three-year, dollar-linked bond, dealers said.

"A large state bank bought about $220 million at the fixing, driving dollar/drachma higher," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank. "The dollar buying which relates to a three-year, dollar-linked bond issued by the Hellenic Republic expiring on April 22 helped prop up ecu/drachma."
Ecu/drachma settled at 308.0 today from 307.3 on Thursday and is currently trading at 308.25/40, traders said.

Ecu/drachma has been rising since Thursday afternoon after a report by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said ERM membership, external imbalances and the overvaluation of the drachma on the basis of PPP (purchasing power parity) signalled risk in 12-month ecu/drachma.
"Next week will show whether this ecu/drachma spike is just a bubble or has a permanent component," said another dealer at a foreign bank.
Dollar/drachma was set at 271.18, up from Thursday's 270.48. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
